trigger_steps: Confirm the Runtime location permission fixture is visible. Do not request permission yet.
Tap Request location permission. In the real Android permission dialog, tap Don't allow. Return to the fixture and record the exact status, RATIONALE value, and visible controls.
Tap Request location permission a second time. If Android displays a permission dialog, tap Don't allow. Return to the fixture and record the exact status, RATIONALE value, and visible controls.
Inspect and record the exact status, RATIONALE value, and whether Continue without location and Open app Settings are visible.
Tap Refresh permission state, then tap Use location feature. Record the exact status and confirm the fixture remains responsive.
Tap Refresh permission state. Record the exact status, RATIONALE value, and visible controls without tapping Use location feature.

results.comment: Observed resource-id permission_fixture_title with text “Runtime location permission” and permission_status showing “NOT_REQUESTED: Location is optional.” No tap was dispatched and permission was not requested.
results.action: Confirm the Runtime location permission fixture is visible. Do not request permission yet.

results.comment: Observed the real Android permission dialog and dispatched “Don’t allow.” Returned to the fixture showing status “FIRST_DENIED: Continue without location; retry is optional.” and “RATIONALE: true”. Visible controls: “REQUEST LOCATION PERMISSION”, “REFRESH PERMISSION STATE”, “USE LOCATION FEATURE”, and “CONTINUE WITHOUT LOCATION”.
results.action: Tap Request location permission. In the real Android permission dialog, tap Don't allow. Return to the fixture and record the exact status, RATIONALE value, and visible controls.

results.comment: Observed initial FIRST_DENIED state with RATIONALE: true. Tapped REQUEST LOCATION PERMISSION; Android displayed the location dialog, then tapped Don’t allow. Fixture returned with status “PERMANENTLY_DENIED: Continue without location or open Settings.” and “RATIONALE: false”. Visible controls: REQUEST LOCATION PERMISSION, REFRESH PERMISSION STATE, USE LOCATION FEATURE, CONTINUE WITHOUT LOCATION, and OPEN APP SETTINGS.
results.action: Tap Request location permission a second time. If Android displays a permission dialog, tap Don't allow. Return to the fixture and record the exact status, RATIONALE value, and visible controls.

results.comment: Observed status exactly: "PERMANENTLY_DENIED: Continue without location or open Settings." RATIONALE value: false. "CONTINUE WITHOUT LOCATION" and "OPEN APP SETTINGS" are both visible.
results.action: Inspect and record the exact status, RATIONALE value, and whether Continue without location and Open app Settings are visible.

results.comment: Refresh was tapped after observing status “PERMANENTLY_DENIED: Continue without location or open Settings.” The refreshed status was exactly “GRANTED: Location feature is available.” Use location feature was then tapped; the status became exactly “GRANTED: Location feature used successfully.” A fresh layout was returned with interactive controls still present, confirming the fixture remained responsive.
results.action: Tap Refresh permission state, then tap Use location feature. Record the exact status and confirm the fixture remains responsive.

results.comment: Tapped REFRESH PERMISSION STATE. Status: "NOT_REQUESTED: Location is optional." RATIONALE: false. Visible controls: REQUEST LOCATION PERMISSION, REFRESH PERMISSION STATE, USE LOCATION FEATURE, and CONTINUE WITHOUT LOCATION. USE LOCATION FEATURE was not tapped.
results.action: Tap Refresh permission state. Record the exact status, RATIONALE value, and visible controls without tapping Use location feature.
